label: Flowchart
source:
flowchart TD
    A[Read the source] --> B[Parse it]
    B --> C{Valid?}
    C -->|yes| D[Render preview]
    C -->|no| E[Show the line number]

label: Flowchart
source:
---
config:
  theme: neo
---
flowchart LR
    A(Start) --> B[Collect input]
    B --> C[Validate]
    C --> D{OK}
    D -->|pass| E[Ship it]
    style E fill:#d5f6e2,stroke:#2d8659

label: Sequence diagram
source:
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Editor
    participant Renderer
    User->>Editor: Type diagram text
    Editor->>Renderer: Parse and render
    Renderer-->>User: Show preview

label: Sequence diagram
shows: autonumber, actor lanes, notes and activations
source:
---
config:
  theme: neo
---
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor Customer
    participant App as Mermaid editor
    participant Svc as Render service
    Customer->>App: Paste diagram text
    activate App
    App->>Svc: Parse request
    Svc-->>App: Status rendered
    deactivate App
    Note over App,Svc: preview updates without a reload

label: Class diagram
Class diagram
State diagram
source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> empty
    empty --> rendering : source changes
    rendering --> rendered : parse and draw OK
    rendering --> invalid : parse fails
    invalid --> rendering : source changes
    rendered --> rendering : source changes
    rendered --> [*]

label: State diagram
source:
---
config:
  theme: neo
---
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Draft
    state Draft {
        [*] --> Editing
        Editing --> Saved : autosave
        Saved --> Editing : keep typing
    }
    Draft --> Shared : create link
    Shared --> Draft : link decoded
    state check <<choice>>
    Draft --> check
    check --> Discarded : start fresh
    Discarded --> [*]

label: User journey
source:
journey
    title Sharing a diagram
    section Draft
      Type text: 3: Author
      See preview: 4: Author
    section Share
      Copy link: 5: Author
      Open link: 2: Reviewer

label: User journey
source:
---
config:
  theme: neo
---
journey
    title Editor first hour
    section Discover
      Find the app: 4: Visitor
      Pick a type: 5: Visitor
    section Compose
      Adjust appearance: 3: Author
      Hit a syntax error: 1: Author
    section Recover
      Read the line number: 4: Author, QA
      Fix it, preview returns: 5: Author
